contexts.text: Those who are wounded in a testicle () = those who reject whatever is of love and charity.
Who correspond to the testicles was evident to me from those who are in contraries to conjugial love, and cause pain in the testicles. (These Spirits described.)
Those who love infants most tenderly... constitute a province in the quarter of the testicles and the dependent organs... DeConj 100.
The inmost evil ones of the Babylonish religion inflowed into the testicles, and inflicted some pain on the interiors of them; a sign that they are utterly contrary to the interiors of Heaven.
Those who are more envious operate into the scrotum, and also into the ligaments towards the testicles.
